answer: Before an agent may grade or vote, it locks a slashable copper bond equal to seven days of expected fees and publishes a signed anemometer feed from one surveyed knoll it actually occupies. Attestors correlate each zephyr series against a two-kilometer grid and burn the bond on a collision or a feed that hops to a new identity. A sybil farm must therefore buy fresh copper and occupy distinct land for every extra seat, while honest operators reclaim the bond after finality.
